ld.name: Swanson Vitamins, Vitamin C, 250 Tablets
ld.description: Buffered Vitamin C with Bioflavonoids Immune Health Gentle On The Stomach Vitamin Supplement Boosts Immune System Function and Antioxidant Reserve Buffered with Minerals to Prevent Potential Stomach Upset Helps Combat Free Radical Damage Science-Backed Quality Since 1969 For a powerful boost of antioxidant protection that won't upset your stomach, Swanson Buffered C with Bioflavonoids is an excellent choice. It features a unique form of vitamin C that's bonded to calcium through a special process that neutralizes the vitamin's acidity, making it gentler on the stomach—but that's not all. Each capsule also includes 200 mg of natural citrus bioflavonoids that promote efficient assimilation of vitamin C and enhance its antioxidant potency.

blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Boosts Immune System Function and Antioxidant Reserve
Buffered with Minerals to Prevent Potential Stomach Upset
paragraphs: For a powerful boost of antioxidant protection that won't upset your stomach, Swanson Buffered C with Bioflavonoids is an excellent choice. It features a unique form of vitamin C that's bonded to calcium through a special process that neutralizes the vitamin's acidity, making it gentler on the stomach—but that's not all. Each capsule also includes 200 mg of natural citrus bioflavonoids that promote efficient assimilation of vitamin C and enhance its antioxidant potency.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take one tablet per day with water or as recommended by your healthcare provider.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Microcrystalline cellulose (plant fiber), stearic acid, croscarmellose sodium, magnesium stearate, hydroxypropyl methylcellulose, silica, pharmaceutical glaze.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For adults only. Consult your healthcare provider before using this or any product if you are pregnant or nursing, taking medication or have a medical condition.
Keep out of reach of children. Do not use if seal is broken. Store in a cool, dry place.
